text:
Clara: FYI opened a docs PR to clarify runtime hints for model cards — context-window guidance, throughput expectations, and suggested batch sizes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421
Matt: nice. can we also call out streaming caveats for quantized variants? they hit CPU fallback around 8k tokens in our tests.
Clara: yes. planning a compact “Runtime hints” subsection on each card. will include a tiny python SDK snippet + a CLI example for quick copy/paste.
Julia: please keep snippets minimal — most folks copy+pasta. collapse the long caveat under a note. :thumbsup:
Prashant: for benchmarks: include p50 + p95 and token/sec for 512 and 2048 seqs? also list hardware used.
Matt: agreed. include p50/p95 and token/sec for two seq lengths and list A10G vs A100S in a one-line hardware note.
Clara: draft python snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(model="zephyrx-8k", input="hello", max_tokens=128, runtime_hints={"batch_size":1, "streaming":True})
print(resp.text)
```
Prashant: minor — runtime_hints isn't public in current SDK. better to show use of request options or documented API surface.
Clara: good catch. will switch to client.request_options in the snippet to match released SDK. updated snippet:```python
client.request_options = {"batch_size":1, "streaming":True}
resp = client.generate(model="zephyrx-8k", input="hello", max_tokens=128)
print(resp.text)
```
Julia: also add a short NOTE at top: requires redwood-sdk >= 1.4.0 for request_options support.
Docs-bot: Link check report: PR 421 flagged 2 dead links (bench CSV, internal perf dash).
Clara: I'll replace bench CSV with the hosted CSV (public storage) and remove internal dash link. also adding a migration note for teams migrating from orion-model names -> new catalog slugs.
Matt: also include a tiny fallback routing example in the model card that shows policy: route to zephyrx-compat if primary is saturated. short YAML snippet should be fine.
Prashant: suggest adding supported quant profiles table (int8, q4_0, q4_1) and one-line tradeoff note (latency vs output fidelity). keeps expectations clear.
Clara: will add the table, the routing YAML, and a brief streaming caveat. aiming to finish updates and push by Tue EOD — tagging reviewers @Julia @Matt @Prashant
Julia: ack, will review once updated.
Matt: LGTM so far, thanks.
Clara: PR updated with fixes (bench link + SDK snippet + quant table) and pushed a small formatting cleanup.
Docs-bot: CI results: linkfix passed, spellcheck passed, linter: one warning (line-length in runtime hints block).
Clara: fixing line length now. will ping when merged.
Matt: thx — this should clear a bunch of support noise about unexpected latency on long sequences.
Docs-bot: Note: please add a short changelog entry under docs/changes/ for this model-card update so downstream teams get notified.
